# Nabla Engine

> Independent scene, simulation and editing foundation for Nabla applications. Studio is only a layer over this package.

<!-- Generated by scripts/document-code.mjs. Edit source contracts, then regenerate. -->

Curated index for agents. Paths are repository-relative from this file. Narrative guides live under `docs/`; module contracts live next to the code as `README.md`; generated signatures live in each folder `REFERENCE.md`. Edit JSDoc in source, then `node scripts/document-code.mjs`. Verify with `--check`.

## Narrative

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Narrative guides for Nabla Engine. Documentation that belongs to a code folder lives next to that code. This index stays with product vision, architecture, usage, operations, decisions, studies and archive.
- [Code reference index](docs/reference/README.md): generated folder table for `REFERENCE.md` pages

## Modules

- [game](game/README.md): Standalone browser game consuming public Engine exports. The playground UI stays in Spanish. Generated signatures: [game reference](game/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 41 functions)
- [src](src/README.md): A game loads this package and a scene JSON. Studio is the editor that writes that JSON. Nothing here imports `studio/`. Generated signatures: [src reference](src/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 0 functions)
- [src/audio](src/audio/README.md): Synthesized vehicle sound. Shared context in `vehicle.ts`; each voice is its own file (turbine, propeller, powertrain, tires). Generated signatures: [src/audio reference](src/audio/REFERENCE.md) (6 modules, 36 functions)
- [src/catalog](src/catalog/README.md): Stock entity factories. Recipes do not become simulation implementations. Generated signatures: [src/catalog reference](src/catalog/REFERENCE.md) (3 modules, 6 functions)
- [src/catalog/monitors](src/catalog/monitors/README.md): Stock layered definitions and the S3 instrument recipe. The renderer does not know about cars. Generated signatures: [src/catalog/monitors reference](src/catalog/monitors/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 3 functions)
- [src/catalog/presentation](src/catalog/presentation/README.md): Model-specific adapters: lights, mounts, paint and police equipment. Generated signatures: [src/catalog/presentation reference](src/catalog/presentation/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 50 functions)
- [src/catalog/vehicles](src/catalog/vehicles/README.md): Stock vehicle definitions are JSON files next to their models, not code. Generated signatures: [src/catalog/vehicles reference](src/catalog/vehicles/REFERENCE.md) (5 modules, 14 functions)
- [src/catalog/weapons](src/catalog/weapons/README.md): Stock weapon recipes. The hitscan sidearm lives in `src/runtime/sidearm.ts`. Generated signatures: [src/catalog/weapons reference](src/catalog/weapons/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 12 functions)
- [src/config](src/config/README.md): Topic-based Engine tuning. Import from `@nabla/engine/config` or `@nabla/engine/config/<topic>`. Generated signatures: [src/config reference](src/config/REFERENCE.md) (9 modules, 8 functions)
- [src/diagnostics](src/diagnostics/README.md): Bounded frame measurements. CPU is main-thread elapsed time, not GPU timing. Generated signatures: [src/diagnostics reference](src/diagnostics/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 10 functions)
- [src/entity](src/entity/README.md): One node's schema and the checks for each kind. Capabilities come from current components, so imported scenes need no flag migration. Generated signatures: [src/entity reference](src/entity/REFERENCE.md) (3 modules, 4 functions)
- [src/entity/landcover](src/entity/landcover/README.md): Authored landcover component. Assembly lives in `src/planet/land`. Generated signatures: [src/entity/landcover reference](src/entity/landcover/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 0 functions)
- [src/entity/light](src/entity/light/README.md): Optional `light` component: `enabled`, `nightOnly`, `color`, intensity (candela) and distance (metres). Shared spotlights are a runtime/render budget, not extra shadow maps. Generated signatures: [src/entity/light reference](src/entity/light/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 0 functions)
- [src/entity/portal](src/entity/portal/README.md): Authored mouths, reciprocal links, validation and rigid transforms. Generated signatures: [src/entity/portal reference](src/entity/portal/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 12 functions)
- [src/entity/road](src/entity/road/README.md): Authored road component. Draped roads are assembled in `src/planet/land/roads`. Generated signatures: [src/entity/road reference](src/entity/road/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 1 functions)
- [src/entity/source](src/entity/source/README.md): Provenance/source fields on authored nodes. Not a download client. Generated signatures: [src/entity/source reference](src/entity/source/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 1 functions)
- [src/entity/sprite](src/entity/sprite/README.md): Billboard/sprite component. Rendering lives in `src/render/entity`. Generated signatures: [src/entity/sprite reference](src/entity/sprite/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 2 functions)
- [src/entity/terrain](src/entity/terrain/README.md): Authored terrain/heightfield fields. Sampling kernels live in `src/math/terrain`. Generated signatures: [src/entity/terrain reference](src/entity/terrain/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 1 functions)
- [src/entity/vehicle](src/entity/vehicle/README.md): Chassis and GLB fields, validation and procedural defaults. Generated signatures: [src/entity/vehicle reference](src/entity/vehicle/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 5 functions)
- [src/examples](src/examples/README.md): Reproducible package content. Uses the same Engine contracts as applications. Generated signatures: [src/examples reference](src/examples/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 3 functions)
- [src/math/frame](src/math/frame/README.md): Vec3 and quaternion tuples. Degrees to quaternion for the UI. Generated signatures: [src/math/frame reference](src/math/frame/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 3 functions)
- [src/math/geo](src/math/geo/README.md): Mean-radius sphere, local east-up-south frame, slippy-tile indices, approximate sun and moon, planet-fixed pose. No OSM tags, no scene documents. Generated signatures: [src/math/geo reference](src/math/geo/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 17 functions)
- [src/math/planar](src/math/planar/README.md): Point-in-polygon and axis-aligned segment clip. Generated signatures: [src/math/planar reference](src/math/planar/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 4 functions)
- [src/math/solid](src/math/solid/README.md): Local mesh topology: box, extrude, validate, triangulate. Generated signatures: [src/math/solid reference](src/math/solid/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 26 functions)
- [src/math/terrain](src/math/terrain/README.md): Heightfield sample and the matching triangle grid. Map rules stay in `src/planet`. Generated signatures: [src/math/terrain reference](src/math/terrain/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 5 functions)
- [src/planet](src/planet/README.md): Map rules that turn a tile into geometry, collisions and published files. Generated signatures: [src/planet reference](src/planet/REFERENCE.md) (8 modules, 20 functions)
- [src/planet/assemble](src/planet/assemble/README.md): District assembler: buildings, ways, cover, water and the sample spawn. Generated signatures: [src/planet/assemble reference](src/planet/assemble/REFERENCE.md) (11 modules, 63 functions)
- [src/planet/buildings](src/planet/buildings/README.md): Rings, footprints and OSM roofs. Numeric solids stay in `src/math/solid`. Generated signatures: [src/planet/buildings reference](src/planet/buildings/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 58 functions)
- [src/planet/collisions](src/planet/collisions/README.md): Cooked collision chunks from published tiles. Installation budgets live in `src/simulation/map-collisions.ts`. Generated signatures: [src/planet/collisions reference](src/planet/collisions/REFERENCE.md) (3 modules, 23 functions)
- [src/planet/extract](src/planet/extract/README.md): Downloaded district and tile source: features, tags, colours and multipolygons. Generated signatures: [src/planet/extract reference](src/planet/extract/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 15 functions)
- [src/planet/land](src/planet/land/README.md): Heightfield, surfaces, draped cover, official land cover and GeoEuskadi road areas. Roads live in `roads/`. Generated signatures: [src/planet/land reference](src/planet/land/REFERENCE.md) (5 modules, 36 functions)
- [src/planet/land/roads](src/planet/land/roads/README.md): Combined and draped road meshes. Clip/sample kernels stay in `src/math`. Generated signatures: [src/planet/land/roads reference](src/planet/land/roads/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 57 functions)
- [src/presentation](src/presentation/README.md): Public `SceneView`: a ready-to-use presenter over `src/render`. Generated signatures: [src/presentation reference](src/presentation/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 1 functions)
- [src/render](src/render/README.md): Turns a `SceneDocument` into a frame. Studio is a client of this folder: gizmos, panels, and the playable editor stay in `studio/`, which will leave this repo. A game imports the presenter from here (also re-exported on `src/index.ts`) and does not need Studio. Generated signatures: [src/render reference](src/render/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 28 functions)
- [src/render/effects](src/render/effects/README.md): Reusable post-process and tyre marks/smoke. Hosts decide when to emit. Generated signatures: [src/render/effects reference](src/render/effects/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 6 functions)
- [src/render/entity](src/render/entity/README.md): How authored entities look: vehicles, lamps, avatar, instruments, thrusters. Generated signatures: [src/render/entity reference](src/render/entity/REFERENCE.md) (21 modules, 267 functions)
- [src/render/monitors](src/render/monitors/README.md): Use the dedicated package entry points:. Generated signatures: [src/render/monitors reference](src/render/monitors/REFERENCE.md) (5 modules, 41 functions)
- [src/render/planet](src/render/planet/README.md): Stream published tiles, distant relief, sky, sun, flare, sea and inland water. Generated signatures: [src/render/planet reference](src/render/planet/REFERENCE.md) (33 modules, 457 functions)
- [src/render/portal](src/render/portal/README.md): Draws a mouth and the place it opens onto. Crossing stays in `simulation/`. Generated signatures: [src/render/portal reference](src/render/portal/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 17 functions)
- [src/render/vehicle-presentation](src/render/vehicle-presentation/README.md): Generic mounts, retractable supports, instruments, lights, mirrors and cameras. Generated signatures: [src/render/vehicle-presentation reference](src/render/vehicle-presentation/REFERENCE.md) (6 modules, 13 functions)
- [src/runtime](src/runtime/README.md): Play lifecycle, controls, cameras and shared browser orchestration. Generated signatures: [src/runtime reference](src/runtime/REFERENCE.md) (24 modules, 219 functions)
- [src/scene](src/scene/README.md): The JSON document, its undo history, and the rigid transform graph. Generated signatures: [src/scene reference](src/scene/REFERENCE.md) (11 modules, 115 functions)
- [src/simulation](src/simulation/README.md): `Simulation` remains the public facade and owner of one Rapier world. It copies the scene, owns player/control selection and runs the fixed-step sequence. Hosts continue to use the same constructor, actions, snapshots and disposal API. Generated signatures: [src/simulation reference](src/simulation/REFERENCE.md) (13 modules, 350 functions)
- [src/simulation/vehicles](src/simulation/vehicles/README.md): Independent wheeled, boat and flight behaviour. They borrow a Rapier body and do not own a world. Generated signatures: [src/simulation/vehicles reference](src/simulation/vehicles/REFERENCE.md) (4 modules, 16 functions)
- [src/simulation/vehicles/wheeled](src/simulation/vehicles/wheeled/README.md): Standalone ground runtime: contacts, drivetrain and telemetry. Generated signatures: [src/simulation/vehicles/wheeled reference](src/simulation/vehicles/wheeled/REFERENCE.md) (3 modules, 18 functions)
- [src/util](src/util/README.md): Small shared helpers: UUID and SHA-256. No scene, physics or rendering. Generated signatures: [src/util reference](src/util/REFERENCE.md) (2 modules, 9 functions)
- [src/viewer](src/viewer/README.md): Geographic viewing API used by Atlas. Viewing does not imply driving or physics acceptance. Generated signatures: [src/viewer reference](src/viewer/REFERENCE.md) (1 modules, 41 functions)
